name: PGWIZ-MD Lite
description: WhatsApp multi-device automation bot with advanced plugin engine

BOT_NAME.description: Custom bot name displayed on menus and captions

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner phone number(s) comma-separated with country code (e.g. 254712345678)

MODE.description: Bot work type mode: public, private, inbox, or groups

ALWAYS_ONLINE.description: Keep bot status constantly online (true or false)

AUTO_STATUS_REACT.description: Automatically react to incoming WhatsApp statuses

AUTO_STATUS_DOWNLOAD.description: Automatically download status media and forward to owner

STATUS_EMOJIS.description: Comma-separated list of emojis for auto status reactions

AUTOREAD.description: Automatically mark chat messages as read

AUTOTYPING.description: Show typing indicator while executing commands

ANTIDELETE.description: Resend deleted messages to owner or group

AUTOREACT.description: Automatically react to incoming messages with emojis

MONGO_URL.description: Optional MongoDB connection URL for persistent cloud storage

FORCE_SESSION_RESET.description: One-time session wipe on startup (set false for normal operation)

TIMEZONE.description: Timezone for time and date commands
